title: 2-Amino-4,6-diarylpyrimidines as potential chronic myeloid leukemia cell inhibitors targeting anti-ABL1 kinase: microwave-assisted synthesis, biological evaluation, molecular docking, and dynamics studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4458-4471

Thi-Anh-Truc Phan, Kim-Khanh-Huy Ngo, Thi-Cam-Thu Nguyen, Thanh-Tan Mai, Hai-Dang Nguyen, Thu-Trang Duong, Le-Phu Tran, Thanh-Tuyen Duong, Thi-Kim-Chi Huynh, Elena V. Koroleva, Zhanna V. Ignatovich, Anastasiya L. Ermolinskaya, Hoang-Phuc Nguyen, Thi-Hong-An Nguyen, Anh-Khoa Ton, Tuong-Ha Do, Thi-Kim-Dung Hoang
2-Amino-4,6-diarylpyrimidines were synthesized in a two-step procedure using MW irradiation. In vitro and in silico experiments showed that 1e is a promising and stable inhibitor of wild and mutant-type ABL1 in chronic myeloid leukemia treatment.
